title: Having seen how far the Spirit works for recognizing Scripture, what belongs to the Church
source_text: XV. Atque ita patet, quam necessario, et quomodo, et quousque, Spiritus sanctus in nobis operetur, ad hoc ut Dei verbum et Scripturam sacram possimus agnoscere. Sequitur ut paucis videamus, quid Ecclesiae quoque hac in re tribuendum sit. Quod fuit tertium caput eorum quae in hujusce disputationis initio, examinanda suscepimus.
pass_a_gloss: And so it is clear how necessarily, and in what manner, and how far, the Holy Spirit works in us toward this end, that we may be able to acknowledge God's Word and sacred Scripture. It follows that we should see in a few words what also is to be attributed to the Church in this matter. Which was the third head of those things which at the beginning of this disputation we undertook to examine.
pass_b_english: So it is clear how necessarily, in what manner, and how far the Holy Spirit works in us so that we can acknowledge God's Word and sacred Scripture. Next we should briefly see what also belongs to the Church in this matter. That was the third head of the things we undertook to examine at the start of this disputation.
